# Laravel Loom

> Static analyzer for Laravel's event-driven primitives — emits a deterministic JSON index.

## Start

- [Laravel Loom](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/)
- [Getting started](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/getting-started/): Scan a Laravel 12.41+ or 13 app on PHP 8.3+, follow one event, and see the same data in the browser.

## Concepts

- [What Loom sees](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/concepts/what-loom-sees/): Loom reads your source without booting the app and records what it finds, one index section per primitive.
- [The index](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/concepts/the-index/): A scan writes one JSON document, `storage/loom/index.json`: metadata, `stats`, then one array per primitive.

## Guides

- [Browse the UI](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/guides/browse-the-ui/): Open `/loom` in your local app and follow `OrderPlaced` through every listener and job it triggers.
- [Ask an agent about your events](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/guides/ask-an-agent/): Register `loom:mcp` with your MCP client so an agent answers from the index instead of grepping your source.
- [Use Loom with Laravel Boost](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/guides/use-with-boost/): Teach agents in a Laravel Boost project when to call Loom, and register its server next to Boost's.
- [Gate your CI on architecture](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/guides/gate-your-ci/): Fail pull requests that add a dead event, a dispatch loop or an unresolved dispatch, and show reviewers what changed.
- [Why was my code missed?](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/guides/why-was-my-code-missed/): When an entry is missing or a link is empty, first look for its file in the unresolved lists.

## Recipes

- [What runs when an event fires](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/recipes/event-chain/): Follow `handled_by` and `dispatches` from one event down to the last handler.
- [What triggers a job](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/recipes/job-triggers/): Before you change a job, walk back from it to every event and route that leads to it.
- [Routes without auth](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/recipes/routes-without-auth/): List every route whose middleware has no `auth` entry.
- [Fail on new unresolved dispatches](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/recipes/new-unresolved-dispatches/): Accept the dispatches Loom can't resolve today and fail the build on any new one.

## Reference

- [Commands](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/reference/commands/): Loom adds five Artisan commands, which read or write one index, by default `storage/loom/index.json`.
- [Check rules and output formats](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/reference/check-rules-and-formats/): The rules, exit codes and output formats of `loom:check` and `loom:diff`; the walkthrough is Gate your CI.
- [GitHub Action reference](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/reference/action/): The Loom composite action scans your branch, runs `loom:check`, diffs against the pull request's base branch and posts one sticky comment.
- [MCP tools](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/reference/mcp-tools/): Every tool `php artisan loom:mcp` serves, with its inputs, a real response and its errors.
- [Schema](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/reference/schema/): Reference for `storage/loom/index.json`, generated from `schema/loom-index.schema.json`.
- [PHP API](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/reference/php-api/): Read a Loom index as typed objects.
- [Index, UI and MCP configuration](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/reference/ui-config/): Every key outside `scan` (Scan configuration), with its default and environment variable.
- [Scan configuration](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/reference/scan-config/): The `scan` keys of `config/loom.php` decide what `loom:scan` reads.
- [What Loom detects](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/reference/detection/): Each page shows the code shapes Loom reads for one primitive, and the ones it does not.
- [Events](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/reference/detection/events/)
- [Listeners](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/reference/detection/listeners/)
- [Closure listeners](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/reference/detection/closure-listeners/)
- [Observers and model hooks](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/reference/detection/observers/)
- [Jobs](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/reference/detection/jobs/)
- [Dispatches](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/reference/detection/dispatches/)
- [Mailables](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/reference/detection/mailables/)
- [Notifications](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/reference/detection/notifications/)
- [Schedule](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/reference/detection/schedule/)
- [Routes](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/reference/detection/routes/)
- [Scan scope](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/reference/detection/scope/)

## Optional

- [Architecture](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/contributing/architecture/): How Loom is wired.
- [Class hierarchy resolver](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/contributing/class-hierarchy/)
- [Add a scanner](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/contributing/add-a-scanner/): Scanners are internal (ADR 0007): one class and one entry in `DefaultScanners`.
- [Architecture Decision Records](https://lucasp1337.github.io/laravel-loom/contributing/adr/): This directory holds load-bearing design decisions: why a path was taken, with the alternatives ruled out.
